plain_statement.en: New route · Printed comparisons and Haar volume · JA-0005 · Check the contradiction from two values assigned to the same lattice

brief.zh: 此声明只检查 1/5 与 1/25 不等。两个槽是否给出同一个实际格及其次数权重，须由 JA-0002、JA-0004 和局部格构造核对。
brief.en: This checks the numerical contradiction between 1/5 and 1/25. Use JA-0002, JA-0004 and the local lattice construction to verify the identification and the weights.
